project_type: Python RAG application with Telegram bot, uses LangGraph, FastAPI, and uv for dependency management
build_system: uv (package manager) + Makefile (task runner) + pre-commit (hook framework)
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py fixtures, pytest-xdist for parallelism, markers (unit, integration, slow, etc.)
test_command: uv run --python 3.12 pytest tests/unit/ --ignore=tests/unit/test_document_parser.py --ignore=tests/unit/test_evaluator.py --ignore=tests/unit/evaluation/test_ragas_evaluation.py --ignore=tests/unit/voice/test_sip_setup.py --ignore=tests/unit/voice/test_voice_agent.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_cocoindex_init.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target_helpers.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target_state_paths.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_target_sync_execution.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_cli.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_flow.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_flow_wiring.py -n auto --dist=worksteal -q --timeout=30 -m 'not legacy_api and not requires_extras and not slow'
verification_instructions: 1) uv sync, 2) make check (lint + type-check), 3) make test-unit (core unit tests), 4) uv run pre-commit run --all-files (test hooks)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Python 3.11 default + pyenv available + uv available. No Docker daemon needed for lint/test validation.
contribution_requirements: Create branch from dev. Run make check + unit tests before pushing. Hooks run lint/static guardrails only - tests are explicit. CI is authoritative.
key_patterns: 1) .pre-commit-config.yaml already has ruff-check/ruff-format for ALL Python (types_or: [python, pyi]), no-commit-to-branch, gitleaks, YAML/TOML/JSON check, bandit/shellcheck/hadolint on pre-push. The hook config scopes by file type not directory, so it already covers telegram_bot/. 2) Makefile lint/format targets only scope src/ but CI runs 'uvx ruff check src/ telegram_bot/'. 3) docs/LOCAL-DEVELOPMENT.md Section 4 says hooks=static guardrails only, tests=explicit local commands. 4) .gitignore lists scripts/no-commit-to-main.sh and scripts/local_pre_push.sh as ignored (legacy, do not exist). 5) Existing contract tests in tests/unit/test_agents_contract.py and tests/unit/test_ci_deploy_workflow.py. 6) No existing DONE JSON validator. 7) default_language_version in .pre-commit-config.yaml is python3.14.
directory_structure: src/ - main RAG source. telegram_bot/ - bot runtime. tests/ - test suite (unit/integration/contract/smoke/etc). scripts/ - operational scripts. skills/superpowers/ - agent skill docs. docs/ - documentation. .github/workflows/ - CI. .kiro/steering/ - agent steering files.
